# BPM / Laws+ compatibility patch - common/political_movements
# Generated by tools/build.py. Do not rename: the zzzzzzzzzz_ prefix keeps
# these files last in the ASCII order the game resolves conflicts by.

# movement_communist
REPLACE:movement_communist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological
	active_law_radicalism_multiplier = 0.75
	ideology = ideology_communist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_communist_leader
		ideology_vanguardist
		ideology_communist
	}
	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = socialism
		global_var:reform_or_revolution_conclusion ?= flag:reform
		country_has_laws_in_need_of_critical_modernization = no
		country_should_exclusively_focus_on_modernization = no
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}
	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				has_technology_researched = socialism
			}
			NOT = {
				global_var:reform_or_revolution_conclusion ?= flag:reform
			}
		}
	}
	on_disbanded = {
	}
	character_support_trigger = {
		scope:interest_group ?= {
			bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
		}
		OR = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
			AND = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
	}
	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			is_pop_type = capitalists
			is_pop_type = aristocrats
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}
	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_below_expected_sol
		movement_support_radicalization
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_laborers
		movement_support_machinists
		movement_support_soldiers_conscripts
	}
	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 10
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.10
				desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = academics
				}
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = laborers
				}
				add = {
					value = 18
					desc = "POP_LABORERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = machinists
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "POP_MACHINISTS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
				}
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						is_pop_type = soldiers
						pop_employment_building = building_conscription_center
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 2
					desc = "CONSCRIPTS"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				standard_of_living < state.average_expected_sol
				strata = lower
			}
			add = {
				desc = "IS_BELOW_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				max = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NOR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proletariat_dictatorship
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = 1.5
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NOR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_union_representation
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = 1.25
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
					}
				}
				standard_of_living > state.average_expected_sol
				strata = lower
			}
			add = {
				desc = "IS_ABOVE_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}
		multiply = {
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					owner = {
						has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "POP_LOYALISTS"
				value = 1
				subtract = pop_loyalist_fraction
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					at_war_with_council_republic = yes
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "AT_WAR_WITH_COUNCIL_REPUBLIC"
				value = 0.75
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_council_republic_law = yes
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = laborers
					is_pop_type = machinists
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "COUNCIL_REPUBLIC_LAW"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_communal_administration
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
					is_pop_type = bureaucrats
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "COMMUNAL_ADMINISTRATION_LAW"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_revolutionary_guard
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
					is_pop_type = officers
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "REVOLUTIONARY_GUARD_LAW"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}
	}
	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}
		weight = {
			value = 100
		}
	}
	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}
		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = movement_radicalism_lack_of_suffrage
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_institution = institution_workplace_safety
				}
				add = {
					value = 3
					subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_workplace_safety)"
					multiply = 0.05
					desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_workplace_safety"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
						law_enactment_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_worker_protections
							value > neutral
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 0.1
					desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_workplace_safety"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_factory_councils
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_is_abolishing_factory_councils = yes
					}
					add = {
						value = 0.25
						desc = "FACTORY_COUNCILS_BEING_ABOLISHED"
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 0.1
					desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_workplace_safety"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = {
					TYPE = movement_communist
				}
				owner = {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							NOT = {
								THIS = ROOT.owner
							}
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
								is_insurrectionary = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NAND = {
						has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
						has_law = law_type:law_factory_councils
					}
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "COMMUNIST_MOVEMENT_REVOLUTIONARISM"
				value = this.political_movement_support
				max = 0.25
				divide = 2
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					at_war_with_revolutionary_council_republic = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "AT_WAR_WITH_REVOLUTIONARY_COUNCIL_REPUBLIC"
				value = 0.25
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				this.days_since_movement_defeated <= very_long_modifier_time
			}
			add = {
				desc = "movement_suppressed_after_civil_war"
				value = this.days_since_movement_defeated
				subtract = very_long_modifier_time
				divide = {
					value = very_long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# movement_radical
REPLACE:movement_radical = {
	category = movement_category_ideological
	ideology = ideology_radical_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_radical
		ideology_nihilist
	}
	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = egalitarianism
		country_should_exclusively_focus_on_modernization = no
		NOR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_corporate_state
		}
		NOR = {
			country_has_german_national_movement = yes
			country_has_italian_national_movement = yes
			country_has_yugoslav_national_movement = yes
			country_has_meiji_restoration_movement = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			AND = {
				OR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
				}
				NOT = {
					c:GER ?= this
				}
				any_political_movement = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_german_national
				}
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_italian
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian
				}
				NOR = {
					c:ITA ?= this
					c:AUS ?= this
					c:KUK ?= this
					c:HRE ?= this
				}
				any_political_movement = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_italian_national
				}
			}
			AND = {
				c:JAP ?= this
				has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
				country_has_pending_meiji_restoration = yes
				any_political_movement = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_meiji_restorationist
				}
			}
		}
	}
	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
			country_has_german_national_movement = yes
			country_has_italian_national_movement = yes
			country_has_yugoslav_national_movement = yes
			country_has_meiji_restoration_movement = yes
			has_council_republic_law = yes
		}
	}
	on_disbanded = {
		fold_movement_into_anti_communist_movement_effect = yes
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				country_has_voting_franchise = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_voting_franchise = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.25
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}
	character_support_trigger = {
		scope:interest_group ?= {
			bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					AND = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
						NOT = {
							owner ?= {
								any_political_movement = {
									OR = {
										is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
										is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
										is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
					scope:interest_group ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			is_pop_type = aristocrats
			is_pop_type = slaves
			AND = {
				is_pop_type = clergymen
				religion = owner.religion
			}
		}
	}
	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_country_is_autocratic
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_radicalization
		movement_support_capitalists
		movement_support_shopkeepers
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_bureaucrats
		movement_support_clerks
		movement_support_machinists
		movement_support_peasants
	}
	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 10
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = upper
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = capitalists
				}
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "POP_CAPITALISTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = shopkeepers
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = academics
				}
				add = {
					value = 80
					desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = bureaucrats
				}
				add = {
					value = 12
					desc = "POP_BUREAUCRATS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
				}
				add = {
					value = 18
					desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = machinists
				}
				add = {
					value = 21
					desc = "POP_MACHINISTS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = laborers
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_LABORERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				add = {
					value = 2
					desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 9
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					country_has_voting_franchise = no
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "COUNTRY_IS_AUTOCRATIC"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_weighted_universal_voting
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.75
				desc = "COUNTRY_IS_DEMOCRATIC"
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}
		multiply = {
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			add = 1
		}
	}
	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}
		weight = {
			value = 100
		}
		state_weight = {
			value = state_urbanization_rate
			add = scope:clout
			add = {
				value = this.turmoil
				divide = 2
			}
			subtract = this.loyalists
		}
	}
	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}
		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
		state_weight = {
			value = state_urbanization_rate
			add = {
				value = this.turmoil
				divide = 2
			}
			subtract = this.loyalists
		}
	}
	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = movement_radicalism_schools_funding
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_institution = institution_police
				}
				add = {
					value = "institution_investment_level(institution_police)"
					subtract = 2
					multiply = 0.05
					desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_police"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = -0.1
					desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_police"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "NO_UNIVERSAL_SUFFRAGE"
					value = 0.15
					multiply = {
						value = owner.modifier:state_expected_sol_from_literacy
						multiply = 0.10
						add = 0.5
					}
					min = 0.15
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_russian_revolution
				}
				add = {
					desc = "russian_revolution_radicalism"
					value = 0.15
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_institution = institution_schools
				}
				add = {
					value = 3
					subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_schools)"
					multiply = 0.05
					desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_schools"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 0.1
					desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_schools"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					country_has_voting_franchise = yes
					electoral_confidence < 0.9
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 1
				subtract = owner.electoral_confidence
				divide = 5
				desc = "low_electoral_confidence"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = {
					TYPE = movement_radical
				}
				owner = {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							NOT = {
								THIS = ROOT.owner
							}
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
								is_insurrectionary = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
		if = {
			limit = {
				this.days_since_movement_defeated <= very_long_modifier_time
			}
			add = {
				desc = "movement_suppressed_after_civil_war"
				value = this.days_since_movement_defeated
				subtract = very_long_modifier_time
				divide = {
					value = very_long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# movement_royalist_absolutist
REPLACE:movement_royalist_absolutist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological
	ideology = ideology_absolutist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_royalist
		ideology_authoritarian
	}
	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = king_in_parliament_possible
				}
				country_has_voting_franchise = yes
			}
			has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
			any_political_movement = {
				OR = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_carlist
					is_political_movement_type = movement_miguelist
				}
			}
			has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
			has_council_republic_law = yes
		}
	}
	on_disbanded = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					country_has_voting_franchise = yes
					NOT = {
						has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
					}
					NOT = {
						has_council_republic_law = yes
					}
					NOT = {
						any_political_movement = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_royalist_constitutional
						}
					}
				}
			}
			owner ?= {
				create_political_movement = {
					type = movement_royalist_constitutional
				}
			}
		}
		fold_movement_into_anti_communist_movement_effect = yes
	}
	creation_trigger = {
		has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		country_has_voting_franchise = no
		NOT = {
			any_political_movement = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_royalist_constitutional
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			any_political_movement = {
				OR = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_carlist
					is_political_movement_type = movement_miguelist
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			c:FRA ?= this
		}
		NOR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
			AND = {
				c:JAP ?= this
				NOT = {
					has_variable = japan_restoration_complete
				}
			}
		}
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_royalist_absolutist
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
				}
			}
			set_core_ideology = ideology_tsarist_movement
		}
	}
	character_support_trigger = {
		scope:interest_group ?= {
			bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
	}
	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}
	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_ruler_popularity
		movement_support_low_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_aristocrats
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_peasants
		movement_support_clergymen
		movement_support_officers
	}
	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 0.5
			subtract = state.state_urbanization_rate
			multiply = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = 5
			desc = "POP_BASE_SUPPORT"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = farmers
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "POP_FARMERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = peasants
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = clergymen
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "POP_CLERGYMEN"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = officers
			}
			add = {
				value = 25
				desc = "POP_OFFICERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = soldiers
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "POP_SOLDIERS"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				owner.ruler ?= {
					NOT = {
						has_trait = trait_child
					}
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				add = owner.ruler.popularity
				multiply = 0.01
				add = 1
				min = 0.2
				max = 1.8
				desc = "RULER_POPULARITY"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				owner.ruler ?= {
					has_trait = trait_child
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.75
				desc = "RULER_IS_CHILD"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				owner.ruler ?= {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy
						value < neutral
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.75
				desc = "RULER_IS_LIBERAL"
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.2
			max = 0.7
		}
	}
	revolution = {
		weight = {
			value = 100
		}
		state_weight = {
			value = 1
			add = scope:clout
			subtract = state_urbanization_rate
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner ?= {
							has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						}
					}
					multiply = 10.0
				}
				else = {
					multiply = 0.1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}
		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
		state_weight = {
			value = 1
			subtract = state_urbanization_rate
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner ?= {
							has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						}
					}
					multiply = 10.0
				}
				else = {
					multiply = 0.1
				}
			}
		}
		forced_tags = {
			BHT = {
				trigger = {
					owner ?= {
						c:BIC ?= this
					}
				}
				weight = 1000
			}
		}
	}
	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = movement_radicalism_royalist_monarchy_abolished
		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = {
					TYPE = movement_royalist_absolutist
				}
				owner = {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							NOT = {
								THIS = ROOT.owner
							}
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_royalist_absolutist
								is_insurrectionary = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
		owner ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_theocracy
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_council_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporatocracy
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 0.25
						desc = "MONARCHY_BEING_ABOLISHED"
					}
				}
				else = {
					add = {
						value = 50
						subtract = legitimacy
						multiply = 0.005
						desc = "concept_legitimacy"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				this.days_since_movement_defeated <= very_long_modifier_time
			}
			add = {
				desc = "movement_suppressed_after_civil_war"
				value = this.days_since_movement_defeated
				subtract = very_long_modifier_time
				divide = {
					value = very_long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

							}
							any_political_movement = {

					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_theocracy
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_council_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporatocracy
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 0.25
						desc = "MONARCHY_BEING_ABOLISHED"
					}
				}
				else = {
					add = {
						value = 50
						subtract = legitimacy
						multiply = 0.005
						desc = "concept_legitimacy"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				this.days_since_movement_defeated <= very_long_modifier_time
			}
			add = {
				desc = "movement_suppressed_after_civil_war"
				value = this.days_since_movement_defeated
				subtract = very_long_modifier_time
				divide = {
					value = very_long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
